title: Supplement to the fourth, fifth and sixth editions of the Encyclopaedia Britannica - Volume 1 - EB.14
text: The analysis of the triscion of an angle, conducted in two different ways, triminates in the construction of the _Conchoid_, a complex curve which was first proposed by Mercedes. As the subject is very curious, and throws great light on the theory of angular magnitude, we shall here not only give both the angent methods of investigation, but subjoin a third which is due to the aspects of Newton.
